newsitem.title: FRANCE: French court orders jail for rap singers.
newsitem.headline: French court orders jail for rap singers.

text.p: Two singers in a French rap band have been given three-month jail terms and banned from performing for six months for using lyrics attacking the police, justice officials said on Friday.

Bruno Lopez, also known as Kool Shen, and Didier Morville, called Joey Star, of the rap group NTM were also handed additional three months' suspended sentences by a Toulon court on Thursday after being convicted of attacking public authorities through their songs.
NTM stands for "Nique Ta Mere" (Fuck Your Mother). The public prosecutor had demanded they each be given a one-year jail sentence, part of it suspended.
Michel Blum, lawyer for Lopez, 30, and Morville, 29, told Reuters they had appealed against the sentences, which put the penalties on hold.
The predominantly North African band has won celebrity, and notoriety, with such song lyrics as "Kill the cops" and "Let's go to the presidential palace and kill all the old people".
One of their songs, "Fuck the police", describes police as "an organised gang, hierarchical, protected by the highest authorities".
Blum argued his clients should be acquitted because their lyrics targeted the police in general rather than individual officers.
The far-right National Front party, which vehemently opposed immigration, has launched a campaign to prevent the group from performing at concerts and festivals which receive public funding.

Last June, after National Front leaders complained, prefect Jean-Charles Marchiani of the Var department in southeastern France pressured a festival near Toulon to cancel an NTM concert by threatening to withdraw subsidies.

Marchiani's action was criticised as censorship by politicians on both the Right and the Left. Socialist ex-culture minister Jack Lang accused the prefect, a member of the ruling Gaullist party, of "playing by the rules of the National Front".
